Dear Madam/ Sir, 
 
Sub: Schedule of Conference call with the Institutional Investors and Analysts 
 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, we hereby inform that a conference call with the 
analysts and investors will be held on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 05:30 PM IST to discuss the 
financial performance of the Company for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. 
The required details are given herein below: 
 
Day and Date 
Thursday, October 29, 2026 
Time 
5:30 p.m. IST / 8:00 p.m. SGT / 12:00 p.m. GMT/ 08:00 a.m. ET

Toll-free dial-in numbers 
Singapore - 800 101 2045 
Hong Kong - 800 964 448 
UK - 0 808 101 1573
